commands.hint: Choose Move, Attack, Skills or Wait. Inspect does not spend your turn.

move_preview.hint: Review the route. Confirm moves; Cancel returns to commands.

target_preview.hint: Review the target and affected units. Confirm commits the action.

inspect_enemy.hint: Inspecting an enemy. Close returns to your previous selection.

choose_facing.hint: Choose a facing, then confirm to end your turn.

resolved.hint: Action resolved. Wait for the next available command.

rules: Preview never changes position, HP, MP or turn order.
Inspect preserves active actor and pending selection.
Cancel restores preceding state without cost.
Confirm must revalidate turn ownership, destination/targets and resources.
Disable duplicate confirmation while resolution is pending.
Facing labels must follow camera orientation, not assume world N means screen up.
